description: This file defines the AppTheme class that provides theme data for light and (potentially) dark themes in a Flutter application. It configures various UI theme aspects like colors, fonts, button styles, and input decorations.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: Provides static methods to generate theme data for Flutter widgets, specifically a light theme configuration.

methods.name: lightTheme
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured with a light theme, including color, typography, and component styles.
